newsitem.title: USA: First Data sees '97 EPS about $1.60/shr.
newsitem.headline: First Data sees '97 EPS about $1.60/shr.

text.p: First Data Corp chairman and chief executive Henry Duques said Thursday he expects 1997 earnings will be "in the neighborhood of" $1.60 per share.
The projection compares to 1996 earnings from operations of $1.35 per share.

Duques told Reuters after a press briefing that he was not making any projection for 1998 other than to say that for the past nine years the company's objective has been to grow revenues, net income and earnings per share approximately 20 percent per year.
